qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Nationwide fiber and mobile physical infrastructure across France, but chronic 4-player price competition (Free/Iliad, SFR, Bouygues) and Spanish low-cost pressure compress 5-year ROIC to ~4% (far below 12% hurdle) and eliminate pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (gate_3b_pricing_and_proof = 'N', REJECT). Sub-hurdle historical returns on capital (5-year ROIC of 3.6-5.2%, well below the 12% threshold) and chronic four-carrier price wars in France (Free, SFR, Bouygues) and Spain eliminate pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Orange operates extensive telecom infrastructure in France, Europe, and MEA. However, capital intensity is massive and 5-year average ROIC is ~4.3% (trailing WACC). French low-cost competition and Spanish promotional pressure prevent real pricing power and sub-hurdle capital returns violate Gate 3b.
